events.description: 20. TEXT ORDER granting 19 Motion to Stay Due to Lapse in Appropriations by United States Citizenship and Immigration Service, Department of Homeland Security, for good cause shown. In light of the lapse of appropriations, the deadline for the parties to file a status report and briefing schedule is stayed until further order of the Court. Counsel for the United States shall file a report within three days after Congress has appropriated funds for the Department of Justice. The schedule for the case moving forward will be assessed by the Court upon such report. Signed by Magistrate Judge Helen C. Adams on 10/15/2025. (k) (Entered: 10/15/2025)
